items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 are loaded with the required labels. Tip racks are in slots 10 and 11, with p20 on the left and p300 on the right.
The loop aspirates 100 µL from reservoir A1 and dispenses 100 µL into each of plate A1 to A12 with p300. No other wells are touched, and the end_state:plate check passed.
The protocol calls p300.pick_up_tip() before any aspiration and drop_tip() at the end. The tip_before_aspirate and tip_dropped_at_end checks passed.
100 µL is within the p300 range, and apiLevel 2.15 is allowed. The simulator ran cleanly and the over-dispense and empty-well checks passed.
The protocol does the single 100 µL transfer to A1:A12 in order. The added liquid definition and the blow-outs do not change the outcome, and the comments are accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware and pipettes, then moves 100 µL from reservoir A1 to each of plate wells A1 to A12 with the p300 using one tip. All measured checks passed and the tip is dropped at the end.
